title: Workday Systems Analyst
jobDescription:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled Workday System Analyst to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in the Workday system in different modules, including business process definitions, securities, advanced compensation, reporting, and security configurations. This role will be pivotal in ensuring the smooth operation and optimization of our Workday system. We are looking for someone with strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Additionally this role will require excellent communication skills and collaboration skills. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast paced environment with the ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Define and manage business processes within Workday to ensure they meet organizational needs.

  • Evaluating and adapting Workday bi-annual feature release.

  • Evaluating and adapting Workday AI features.

  • Oversee advanced compensation processes, including merit cycles, bonus plans, and equity plans.

  • Manage position management processes, ensuring accurate and efficient handling of job requisitions, position changes, and organizational hierarchies.

  • Develop and maintain custom reports for business needs.

  • Configure and manage security roles and permissions to ensure data integrity and compliance with internal policies.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement system improvements and enhancements.

  • Provide training and support to end-users to maximize the effective use of Workday.

Who You Are

  • A "Learn-it-all": You stay ahead of the curve on Workday features and best practices, constantly looking for ways to leverage new functionality to solve business problems.

  • A Trust Builder: You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical teams (Finance, IT, HR), translating complex system requirements into clear business solutions.

  • Resilient & Analytical: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and use your strong analytical skills to troubleshoot issues and "make results happen," even when the path forward isn't immediately clear.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field

  • 3+ years of experience working with Workday, specifically in business process definitions, advanced compensation, position management, reporting, and/or security

Preferred Qualifications

  • Workday certification in any module

  • Experience with Workday reporting tools, including custom report writing

  • Familiarity with Workday security configuration and role-based permissions

  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically


Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA. Time zones: San Francisco is the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time – for example, 8AM in San Francisco is 8:30 PM in Bengaluru. Standard working hours in San Francisco are between 8AM – 6PM. For this role, applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time.


About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care.

As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com/

What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA).

  • Well-being support: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally.

  • Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

Culture & Engagement

title: Product Manager
jobDescription:
The Opportunity

Care Ops is the platform pod within Care Hub that powers how Hinge Health's care team operates at scale. As the PM for Care Ops, you'll drive a high-impact roadmap: improving workload distribution across the care team through algorithmic engine enhancements, migrating complex operational workflows into a modern internal platform, automating member offboarding, and supporting the rollout of new care programs. You'll partner closely with Demand Enablement, Member Ops, Clinical Operations, and a Bangalore-based engineering team, with significant collaboration with US-based stakeholders. This role sits within the Care Hub neighborhood and reports to the Director of Product for Care Hub.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Design the strategy to overhaul our internal tool for workforce management. This includes RBAC, audit logging, and key features like dashboards, dynamic coverage management and more

  • Reduce operational average handle time for key workflows

  • Define MVPs, set KPIs, and build out a multi quarter roadmap for the Care Ops pod with clearly defined success metrics and delivery milestones

  • Experience with algorithmic systems such as matching, scheduling, routing, or capacity management

title: Senior Software Engineer
jobDescription:
The Opportunity

Join the Growth Data Platform team to build the decision engine behind Hinge Health’s growth. GDP is the platform that powers the data pipelines, event streams, and intelligence layer that shape member experiences across the growth journey, from the first marketing touchpoint to personalized engagement moments like Daily Streak notifications.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents.

  • Collaborate with your team to roadmap and execute ambitious technical strategies, balancing short-term and long-term trade-offs.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing.

  • Design and build AI-powered clinical agents using Lang Graph.js for stateful orchestration, composing multi-node State Graphs that handle context gathering, LLM reasoning, and action execution within a shared Nest JS service.

  • Integrate Lang Smith for end-to-end AI observability, including prompt versioning and management via Lang Smith Hub, automated per-node tracing, evaluation pipelines with golden datasets, and CI-gated quality checks that block regressions before merge.

  • Develop and maintain agentic workflows that leverage LLMs (Claude Sonnet via AWS Bedrock)

  • Contribute to the Member-Centric Knowledge Graph and RAG-based retrieval systems that give agents the clinical context, causal evidence, and relationship awareness needed for intelligent decision-making.

  • Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team's features, and contribute to the team's overall architecture and developer tooling.

  • Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field

  • At minimum, 3-4 + years of non-internship full time professional software development experience

  • At minimum, 3+ years of work experience Node JS/ Typescript

  • Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot or Cursor

  • Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment.

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience building applications with LLMs, including prompt engineering, model integration (e.g., Open AI, Anthropic/Claude, AWS Bedrock), and evaluating AI output quality

  • Experience with agentic AI frameworks such as Lang Graph, Lang Chain, or similar orchestration libraries for building stateful, multi-step AI workflows

  • Familiarity with Lang Smith or equivalent AI observability/evaluation platforms for tracing, prompt management, and regression testing of LLM-powered features

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5 + years of non-internship full time professional software development experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) or Masters in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field

  • Experience with AI technologies for software design and coding assistance

  • Experience mentoring or onboarding junior engineers

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or scalable architectures

  • Implement feature-flag-gated deployments for growth infrastructure changes, ensuring safe rollout of new event handling and email delivery logic without disrupting existing member journeys.

  • Understanding of responsible AI practices including PHI/PII handling, guardrails, and output validation in healthcare or regulated environments

  • Experience writing ML model prediction outputs into the CDP via Segment custom events, bridging DS/ML model scoring to member-facing campaign activation in Iterable.

title: Senior Software Engineer-Backend
jobDescription:
The Opportunity

As a Senior Software Backend Engineer at Hinge Health, you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable software solutions that directly improve member health outcomes. You will work closely with cross-functional partners, including product managers, designers, and fellow engineers, to deliver new capabilities and enhance the maintainability, reliability, and performance of our products.

In this role, you will help advance Hinge Health’s mission to transform joint and muscle care through technology. This includes contributing to AI-driven solutions that automate workflows, improve care delivery, and create better experiences for both care teams and members. Hinge Health engineers work in small, interdisciplinary teams aligned to different parts of the member journey, with strong ownership from development through production.

You will join the Care Hub team, which is building the platform where care happens at Hinge Health. Care Hub is the unified system that equips physical therapists, health coaches, care managers, and other care teams with the tools they need to deliver personalized, high-quality musculoskeletal care. It brings together member history, care plans, documentation, communication, and daily workflows in one place, enabling clinicians to spend less time navigating systems and more time supporting members.

As Care Hub 2.0 evolves, the team is modernizing the platform to improve performance, scalability, and user experience, while also introducing AI-powered capabilities that simplify workflows and increase operational efficiency across care delivery.

We operate in a continuous deployment Dev Ops culture and take owner-operator pride in supporting our code in production. Our production systems use technologies including React Native, React, Node.js, Type Script, Nest JS, Graph QL, Docker, Rails, AWS, Postgres, Redis, Apollo, and Redux. Our engineering workflow follows trunk-based CI/CD, and our security and compliance standards meet the demands of healthcare, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and CCPA.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents.

Who You Are

  • A "Learn-it-all": You are proficient in modern stacks (Type Script, Node.js) but remain curious. You leverage AI tools to accelerate your workflow and are eager to explore new technologies to solve complex problems.

  • A Trust Builder: You communicate complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners (Product Managers, Designers), ensuring everyone is aligned on shared goals.

  • Resilient & Solution-Oriented: You break down complex problems into manageable tasks, navigating ambiguity to deliver results even when the path isn't perfectly defined.

  • An Owner-Operator: You take pride in supporting your code in production, embracing a Dev Ops culture where you build, deploy, and own your solutions.
